body:
# Damage2Health

This mod makes it so that whenever you deal damage to a mob, your maximum health increases by the same amount of damage dealt. (Does not affect players.)

## How to Install (Windows)

1. Download the mod `.jar` file.
2. Make sure you have the correct mod loader (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, etc.) installed for the Minecraft version this mod supports.
3. Press **Windows + R**, type `%appdata%`, and press **Enter**.
4. Open the `.minecraft` folder.
5. Open the `mods` folder. If it doesn't exist, create a new folder named `mods`.
6. Drag the downloaded `.jar` file into the `mods` folder.
7. Launch Minecraft using the profile for the correct mod loader and Minecraft version.

The mod should now be installed.

## Notes

* Make sure you're using the correct Minecraft version and mod loader for the version of the mod you downloaded.
* Some mods require additional dependencies (such as Fabric API). If required, they will be listed on the mod's download page.
* This mod has been tested on Windows 10 and CachyOS. It should also work on other operating systems that support Minecraft Java Edition, provided the correct mod loader is installed.

**CurseForge Version:** https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/damage2health
